english.title: Fail to produce driving licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_

on a road namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to produce for examination your licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See offence wording H3311 for failure to produce an lgv /pcv licence to an authorised officer other than a constable, and H36 for failure to produce driving licence and counterpart.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant,

(A)_[having been the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[who was suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[who was suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), failed to produce a current driving licence to a police constable when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.
